bg=1
grid=[[bg]*W for _ in range(H)]

 9:[(5,6),(6,4),(6,5),(6,6)],

}
# Move 9,7,4 to top; 8,5,6 to bottom, retaining each shape's coordinates.
up={9,7,4}
for color, cells in objs.items():
    minr=min(r for r,c in cells); maxr=max(r for r,c in cells)
    dr=-minr if color in up else (H-1-maxr)
    for r,c in cells:
        rr=r+dr
        assert grid[rr][c]==bg, (color,rr,c,grid[rr][c])
        grid[rr][c]=color
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in grid))
import json
